ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio (~1:20) between the predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) ventral surface and localized high-intensity (white) scar tissue and barnacle clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogenous low-intensity field across both lobes, interrupted by discrete high-intensity white linear and circular clusters distributed across the central and distal regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped median notch with an approximate 50-degree angle and a vertical depth comprising roughly 10% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern along the trailing edge with variable pixel-amplitude peaks, particularly pronounced on the inner curve of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex sweep trajectories curving upwards from the notch towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distributed circular high-intensity white pixel clusters (2-10 pixel diameters) consistent with barnacle scarring across the central and lower regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: High-contrast white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) predominantly oriented in vertical and diagonal vectors across the inner regions of the lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Densely packed white/off-white calcified clusters (barnacles) on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small, distinct circular high-contrast white spot located in the lower-central quadrant of the left lobe.
